description_for_human: Score any public website against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, llmstxt.org, and agent-protocol specs (MCP, A2A, agents.json, NLWeb). Returns a 0–100 score with per-check pass/fail and fixes.
description_for_model: Use Agent Ready to evaluate or improve how well a website supports AI agents and LLMs. Given a public URL, it scores the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llmstxt.org specification, and agent-protocol specs (MCP, A2A, agents.json, agent-permissions.json, UCP, x402, NLWeb) — 72 checks across discovery, structure, and context — and returns per-check pass/fail with actionable remediation. All operations are read-only and safe to call; only public URLs are scanned (private, local, and reserved addresses are refused). To run a scan: POST a URL to the scans operation, then poll the scan-by-id operation until status is `complete` and read the `checks` array. See the OpenAPI spec referenced below for the full contract.
